types.description: Selector switch operating head, Harmony XB4 metal, black standard (short) handle, Ø22, 3 positions (1-0-2) ±45°, stay put — head only, no contact block

document.title: Harmony XB4 metal — Control and signaling units, catalog
document.pages: Catalog p.54 (physical PDF p.56): Selector switches with standard handle, Heads only — ZB4BD3; note (1) body=fixing collar+contact, see p.24/p.74

modelingNotes: Mechanical operating head only. The manufacturer catalog prints the reference ZB4BD3 without the presentation hyphen; the source order code ZB4-BD3 is the same part. expectedOrderNumber 'ZB4-BD3' is retained per job identity.

Catalog p.54 'Heads only' rows carry no NO/NC contact counts. Contacts exist only on complete units, e.g. XB4BD33 = ZB4BZ103 (body/contact) + ZB4BD3 (head); the '2 NO' contacts belong to the ZB4BZ103 body, not to this head. No contacts, LEDs, supply, return, signal or communication terminals are part of ZB4-BD3.
Zero electrical terminals: modeled as a documentation/accessory view. The ±45° three-position maintained (1-0-2) scheme is a mechanical position indicator, not an electrical wiring diagram.

Metal head with chromium-plated bezel; the catalog documents no earth/bonding terminal on the head. Any bonding of the metal bezel through panel, fixing collar or metalwork is undocumented and is NOT asserted as a manufacturer fact — hence partial connection coverage with zero documented terminals.

Body/fixing collar (e.g. ZB4BZ009) and contact blocks (e.g. ZBE-101 NO / ZBE-102 NC) or a preassembled body (e.g. ZB4BZ103) are separately ordered parts and are not included or modeled here. The black-metal-bezel variant is a distinct code ZB4BD37 (suffix 7); the source ZB4-BD3 has no such suffix and is the standard head.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical operating head with zero documented electrical terminals. Contacts/LEDs live on a separately-ordered XB4 body (fixing collar + contact blocks), not on this head. The metal-bezel bonding/earthing interface is undocumented and not asserted; hence partial rather than complete.

MOUNT.connector: Ø22 mm panel-mount operating head; couples to a separately-ordered Harmony XB4 body (fixing collar ZB4BZ009 + contact/light blocks, or a preassembled body such as ZB4BZ103)
MOUNT.description: Mechanical actuation interface only. The head transmits ±45° three-position maintained (1-0-2) motion to contact blocks mounted on the body. No electrical pins on the head itself.
